issue (cited in the notes as #49290): Consolidate values API for CNI (values.cni vs values.istio_cni) [closed; labels kind/need more info, lifecycle/staleproof]
We currently have two almost-identical looking fields in the values that are concerned with CNI. The first is `values.cni` which if `enabled` is set to `true` will install CNI with the settings as they are configured in `values.cni`.

There's another field called `values.istio_cni` which only has two settings:

```
values:
istio_cni:
# if true, istiod will attempt to use an existing CNI installation
enabled: true
# has an effect on som…

between them is that `values.cni` is the actual CNI configuration and installation, so it works like other parts of the values API, but `istio_cni` actually just configures istiod and the injection template to use an existing CNI installation - the distinction is necessary for cases like remote istiod, where you might want to enable CNI usage, but not install it, or if you're managing the lifecycles of istiod and CNI separately and want to be able to enable CNI usage without having to reinstall.

PR: Remove deprecated `istio_cni` values from pilot chart [closed; labels size/XXL]
The `istio_cni` values are strictly redundant with/replaced by `pilot.cni` values, and [were explicitly marked deprecated 2+ releases ago](https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/master/manifests/charts/istio-control/istio-discovery/values.yaml#L513) in PR: https://github.com/istio/istio/pull/49495

See also: https://github.com/istio/istio/issues/49290
